description: A donut chart with the total user count shown in its center.
overview: A `PieChart` donut with small gaps and rounded slice corners. `chartData` holds one record per device with a `users` count. The total is summed from `chartData` and drawn as `Text` layered over the ring. Pressing a slice shows a tooltip.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records; the center total recalculates from it. Update the `users` caption and `chartConfig` labels and colors to match. The component takes no props.
